Priority Calculation

{priority_justification}

Legend

Direct Impact
Immediate callers and dependencies of the affected components.
Transitive Impact
Reachable components via 2-3 hops in the call graph, weighted by distance decay (hop 1.0→0.7→0.4) and relationship type (call/import/data/semantic).
High-Confidence Impact
Transitive nodes with weight ≥0.8, OR high centrality (fan-in > 5), OR directly involved in execution failures.
Priority Formula
raw_score = (impact × confidence_ratio) / (effort × risk), where confidence_ratio is 0-1 (not a percentage). The 0-100 score shown is raw_score normalized against the minimum and maximum raw_score across every opportunity in this report — priority is relative to what else this audit surfaced, not an absolute scale. See each opportunity's Priority Calculation section for its raw_score and this report's range.
Risk Levels
Small: <5 files. Medium: 5-20 files. Large: >20 files.
